bayts.text: You have taken away my doubt, and it shall never return to me: the Restorer (Al-Muʿīd) has annihilated it.
Bless with a blessing that is for my person delights without end, with an accepted peace,
upon him who is gladdened by my serving him, foremost among the servants.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And come between me and doubt through him, O You Who soften the rock like a levelling.
And increase my longing for Your good pleasure, O You Who raise the servant if he has pleased You.
And make my heart detached from all that You have not approved for me, and guide me as a teacher.
And prevent the turning of straying and wrath toward my sides, and spare me all wrath.
And enrich me through You, together with the permitted, unto the Gardens, and increase my gain.
Grant me in the permitted, for me, the rewards of Your radiant servants; and never shall I be unjust.
And make my life free of sins, of every wrongdoer and every rebel.
Āmīn, O Lord of the heaven and the earth, O You to Whom I have conveyed the best of obligations.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have spared me the hateful things of the two Abodes, You have spared me the two disgraces and the two fires.
Bless with a blessing that honours my side, with a lasting peace, O Most Generous,
upon him by whose service You honoured me, O Guardian Who preserved me from its shock.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me today and after today the preservation of all of me from harm and blame.
You have made my heart a receiver of the best knowledge, You have made all of me a striver in the best striving.
You have granted me today my undertaking of the Book, and what You chose for me: I have been preserved from reproach.
And protect my whole being from disobedience, and make my intention like the deeds of the righteous.
You have granted me remembrance (of God) with sweetness, and led teaching and recitation to me.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have brought to completion my sale and my striving with letters, O Everlasting Who have been for me with the fullness of vessels.
Bless with a blessing that bears witness to my gratitude, with a peace that bears witness to my sufficiency,
upon him whose servant You have made me, and who has secured pre-eminence for me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And reward him on my behalf with a good never seen for others than him, and for others than him it shall never be seen.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have taken away all that grieves me toward others than me, and made the finest favours eternal for me.
Bless with a blessing that makes my life clear for me, with a peace that sets my affair right for me,
upon him who honoured me with my being a marvel from him for all creation.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have taken from me all doubt and illusion, and led to my heart a hidden knowledge.
Bless with a blessing that drives faults toward other than my person, that unveils mysteries
to my heart, shining, illumining, with a peace that takes away disgrace
toward other than my writing, my tongue and the letters, upon him who through me shows every noble one.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And raise my writing to Your mighty Throne, O You Who effaced what grieves me with remission.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Bless with a blessing that drives the envious toward other than my direction, that bars the corrupters
(access) to my pen, my body and my heart, with a peace that preserves from despoiling,
upon him who has granted me honour and glad tidings that shall not depart from me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me today and after today my being preserved without blame.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have granted me from You constancy in glad tidings, and toward others than me You drove the Nineteen (guardians of Hell, Qurʾān 74:30).
Bless with a blessing that leads the Muslims to me, with a peace that preserves from the criminals,
upon him through whom You made my dwelling good for me, as You drew my station to me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me today the permitted things of humankind, and make my life for the Prophet the best glad tidings.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
